lines.zh: 我踏着草地小跑，肚子一晃一晃。
lines.en: I trot across the grass, my belly swaying with each step.

lines.zh: 四条短腿转得很快，路却走不远。
lines.en: Four short legs churn fast, yet I cover very little ground.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停下，闻闻有没有吃的。
lines.en: I stop every two steps to sniff for something to eat.

lines.zh: 泥土软，我的蹄子陷进去又拔出来。
lines.en: The soil is soft; my hooves sink in and pull free.

lines.zh: 我顺着胡萝卜的味道往前挪。
lines.en: I shuffle forward along the smell of carrots.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不想撞到膝盖。
lines.en: I skirt the stones so I do not bang my knees.

lines.zh: 风把我的耳朵吹得往后贴。
lines.en: The wind flattens my ears back against my head.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边哼哼，没人应我。
lines.en: I grunt as I walk, and nobody answers.

lines.zh: 草叶扫过我的肚子，有点痒。
lines.en: Grass blades brush my belly and make me itchy.

lines.zh: 我走去河边，那里草更嫩。
lines.en: I head for the riverbank, where the grass is tenderer.

lines.zh: 身后跟着一只同伴，我们并排走。
lines.en: A companion follows behind, and we walk side by side.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，反正没人追我。
lines.en: I do not walk fast; nobody is chasing me anyway.

lines.zh: 脚步落下，土里冒出一点灰。
lines.en: Each footfall kicks a little dust out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一路都是我能吃的叶子。
lines.en: The whole way is lined with leaves I can eat.

lines.zh: 我穿过一片矮草，蹄子很轻。
lines.en: I cross the low grass on light hooves.

lines.zh: 小跑一段，我又回头等同伴。
lines.en: I trot ahead, then turn to wait for my friend.

lines.zh: 我站着嚼草，嚼得很慢。
lines.en: I stand and chew grass, very slowly.

lines.zh: 太阳晒在背上，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: The sun warms my back and I squint.

lines.zh: 我在数今天吃到几种叶子。
lines.en: I am counting how many kinds of leaves I ate today.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我先把嘴里的草咽下。
lines.en: Someone approaches, so I swallow the grass in my mouth first.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，味道是青草味的。
lines.en: I burp, and the taste is green grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩一甩，赶走一只蝇。
lines.en: I flick my tail to shoo away a fly.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把肚子贴在土上。
lines.en: I settle down and press my belly to the soil.

lines.zh: 这块草地归我，我先站一会儿。
lines.en: This patch of grass is mine; I will stand here a while.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西叫，不像我。
lines.en: Something calls in the distance, and it is not my kind.

lines.zh: 没事做的时候，我就嚼得更慢。
lines.en: When there is nothing to do, I chew even slower.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的影子看，它也盯着我。
lines.en: I stare at my shadow, and it stares back.

lines.zh: 风里有熟果子的甜味。
lines.en: The wind carries the sweetness of ripe fruit.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭树干，背上有点痒。
lines.en: I rub against a trunk; my back is itchy.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出不怎么尖的牙。
lines.en: I yawn, showing teeth that are not very sharp.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进草里，闻了很久。
lines.en: I bury my nose in the grass and sniff a while.

lines.zh: 今天没什么事，我就慢慢站着。
lines.en: Nothing to do today, so I just stand here.

lines.zh: 你手里的是胡萝卜吗，我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that a carrot in your hand? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子上的肉挤成一圈。
lines.en: I look up at you, and my neck folds into a ring.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，想把你看成两棵草。
lines.en: I cock my head and try to see you as two tufts of grass.

lines.zh: 你不像狼，你身上没有那种味道。
lines.en: You are not a wolf; you do not carry that smell.

lines.zh: 我靠近半步，又退回去半步。
lines.en: I take half a step closer, then half a step back.

lines.zh: 你的手放低一点，我就不怕了。
lines.en: Lower your hand a little and I will stop being afraid.

lines.zh: 你两个口袋都鼓，左边那个更香。
lines.en: Both your pockets bulge, and the left one smells better.

lines.zh: 我眼睛小，但我看得很仔细。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but I look very carefully.

lines.zh: 你要摸我，就先让我闻闻你。
lines.en: If you want to pet me, let me sniff you first.

lines.zh: 我眨了下眼，眼睫毛比你的短。
lines.en: I blink once, and my lashes are shorter than yours.

lines.zh: 你要真是不动的树，我就啃树皮了。
lines.en: If you really were a still tree, I would chew your bark.

lines.zh: 我小声哼了一下，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I grunt softly, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 疼，我跑不动了，只能走。
lines.en: It hurts; I cannot run, only walk.

lines.zh: 你打中我的腿，我踉跄了一下。
lines.en: You hit my leg and I stumble a little.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音又短又哑。
lines.en: I cry out, short and hoarse.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，把肚皮护住。
lines.en: I pull in my neck to guard my belly.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被狼追的那天。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the day the wolf chased me.

lines.zh: 我血不多，流一点就头晕。
lines.en: I have little blood; a little loss makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 别打了，我没什么能给你的。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I have nothing to give you.

lines.zh: 我往草丛里钻，草能挡一挡。
lines.en: I push into the tall grass, which shields me a little.

lines.zh: 伤口在发烫，我用舌头舔。
lines.en: The wound burns, so I lick it.

lines.zh: 我记住了这个味道，是你的。
lines.en: I have memorized this smell, and it is yours.

lines.zh: 那根胡萝卜，能不能分我一口。
lines.en: That carrot, could I have a bite of it?

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，腿自己就过来了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet and my legs come on their own.

lines.zh: 你手心朝上，我就敢凑近。
lines.en: With your palm turned up, I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只跟着那袋种子。
lines.en: I follow you, but only the bag of seeds.

lines.zh: 我嘴里嚼着草，心里想着胡萝卜。
lines.en: I chew grass while thinking about carrots.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我跟一步，很守规矩。
lines.en: You take a step, I take a step, very politely.

lines.zh: 麦子也行，我不挑食。
lines.en: Wheat will do as well; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 我把湿鼻子按在你掌心，别笑。
lines.en: I press my wet nose into your palm; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起小时候的草地。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of the grass where I was young.

lines.zh: 你背过身去，胡萝卜味还留着。
lines.en: You turn your back, but the carrot smell stays.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里只有吃的。
lines.en: I look up at you, and my eyes hold only food.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就跟你回家。
lines.en: Come a little closer and I will follow you home.

lines.zh: 我只用鼻尖碰一碰，不咬。
lines.en: I only touch it with my snout; I do not bite.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，比草好吃多了。
lines.en: What you hold tastes far better than grass.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高了，我会站起来的。
lines.en: Hold it high. I will stand up for it.

lines.zh: 我小跑过来，蹄子都刹不住。
lines.en: I trot over, hooves skidding.

lines.zh: 哎，你踩到我的蹄子了。
lines.en: Hey, you stepped on my hoof.

lines.zh: 我往旁边让，可身体太宽。
lines.en: I try to shift aside, but I am too wide.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，我皮厚。
lines.en: A bump does not hurt; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 你别挤，我正在嚼东西。
lines.en: Do not shove; I am busy chewing.

lines.zh: 这栅栏口只够一头过去，让我先。
lines.en: This gap in the fence fits one of us; let me go.

lines.zh: 我推了你一下，不是故意的。
lines.en: I pushed you, and it was not on purpose.

lines.zh: 你、我，再加这条窄路。
lines.en: You, me, and this narrow path, all squeezed together.

lines.zh: 我的肚子先碰到你，然后才是头。
lines.en: My belly reaches you before my head does.

lines.zh: 站稳，我不想把你顶倒。
lines.en: Stand firm; I do not want to knock you over.

lines.zh: 擦过去的时候，我的毛蹭到你了。
lines.en: As I brush past, my bristles scrape against you.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈走，谁也不先低头。
lines.en: We circle each other, and neither lowers their head first.

lines.zh: 她闻了闻我，我就知道成了。
lines.en: She sniffs me, and I know it is settled.

lines.zh: 我把最嫩的草推到她面前。
lines.en: I push the tenderest grass in front of her.

lines.zh: 你把眼睛移开，我们才继续。
lines.en: Look away, and only then will we continue.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，尾巴碰尾巴。
lines.en: We stand side by side, tail touching tail.

lines.zh: 过些日子，会多一只小的。
lines.en: In a while, there will be a small one more.

lines.zh: 我哼得很轻，只给她听。
lines.en: I grunt very softly, for her alone.

lines.zh: 她走开，我跟上去，不远不近。
lines.en: She walks off and I follow, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 这块草地够我们两个吃。
lines.en: This meadow has enough grass for the two of us.

lines.zh: 等小家伙出生，我教它找草。
lines.en: When the little one comes, I will teach it to find grass.

lines.zh: 地上那颗种子，我闻了闻，没捡。
lines.en: I sniff the seed on the ground and leave it.

lines.zh: 我用上唇把种子卷进嘴里。
lines.en: I roll the seed into my mouth with my upper lip.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只会吃。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I only eat them.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢下，我就当你请客。
lines.en: If you drop something, I take it as a gift.

lines.zh: 我拱了拱，它滚到石头底下。
lines.en: I nudge it and it rolls under a stone.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞不下，只能含着。
lines.en: It will not fit in my mouth, so I just hold it.

lines.zh: 掉的果子归我，谁先到归谁。
lines.en: Fallen fruit is mine; first come, first served.

lines.zh: 我低头找，找了半天是块石子。
lines.en: I search and search, and it turns out to be a pebble.

lines.zh: 这东西不甜，我吐出来了。
lines.en: This thing is not sweet, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在鼻子上，走两步就掉。
lines.en: I balance it on my nose; two steps and it drops.

lines.zh: 那边有动静，我先看看是什么。
lines.en: Something moved over there; let me see what it is.

lines.zh: 是狼吗，我的腿想跑了。
lines.en: Is that a wolf? My legs want to run.

lines.zh: 我看见一只同伴，我要过去。
lines.en: I see a companion, and I am going over.

lines.zh: 有人在扔胡萝卜，我锁定它了。
lines.en: Someone is tossing carrots, and I have locked on.

lines.zh: 那不是草，那是一只狐狸。
lines.en: That is not grass; that is a fox.

lines.zh: 我先盯住它，再决定要不要怕。
lines.en: I will watch it first, then decide whether to fear it.

lines.zh: 远处的影子在动，我不喜欢。
lines.en: A shadow moves in the distance, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我认准了那块菜地，今晚去。
lines.en: I have picked that vegetable patch; tonight I go.

lines.zh: 它比我小，我不用退。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, so I need not back off.

lines.zh: 目标就在那，可我走得很慢。
lines.en: The goal is right there, but I walk very slowly.

lines.zh: 我一直看着它，它也在看我。
lines.en: I keep watching it, and it watches me back.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，其实只是准备跑。
lines.en: I crouch low, though I am only preparing to run.

lines.zh: 别过来，我会用头顶你。
lines.en: Do not come closer; I will butt you with my head.

lines.zh: 我盯着那块地，草长得最好。
lines.en: I stare at that patch, where the grass grows best.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的耳朵就转向它。
lines.en: When it moves, my ears swing toward it.

lines.zh: 我数到三就走，一，二……
lines.en: I will leave on three: one, two...

lines.zh: 我把蹄子在地上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I scrape my hoof against the ground.

lines.zh: 它挡住了去菜地的路。
lines.en: It is blocking the way to the vegetable patch.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，把鼻子埋进草丛。
lines.en: I hold my breath and bury my snout in the grass.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就转身走。
lines.en: One step closer and I turn and walk away.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，就一下。
lines.en: I butted you once, just once.

lines.zh: 我的头很硬，但你不会疼太久。
lines.en: My head is hard, but it will not hurt you long.

lines.zh: 别抢我的草，我咬你裤脚。
lines.en: Do not take my grass, or I will bite your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，半路就减速了。
lines.en: I charge, then slow down halfway there.

lines.zh: 我冲了五步，最后一步软了。
lines.en: I charge five steps, and the last one falters.

lines.zh: 我撞完就后悔了，往后退。
lines.en: I regret the hit at once and back away.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只有一股倔劲。
lines.en: I have no fangs, only a stubborn streak.

lines.zh: 你让开半格，我就掉头吃草。
lines.en: Give me half a block and I turn back to the grass.

lines.zh: 蹄子刨起土，扬了你一脸。
lines.en: My hooves throw dirt into your face.

lines.zh: 打完了，我们还能做朋友吗。
lines.en: Now that it is over, can we still be friends?

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先看见一片草地。
lines.en: I open my eyes and the first thing I see is grass.

lines.zh: 这里草够多，我就住下了。
lines.en: There is enough grass here, so I will stay.

lines.zh: 我从土里出来，身上还带着泥。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil still covered in mud.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找吃的，第二件是睡。
lines.en: First I find food; second I sleep.

lines.zh: 这地方很陌生，但草是熟的。
lines.en: The place is strange, but the grass is familiar.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，把尘土抖掉。
lines.en: I shake myself and dust flies off.

lines.zh: 有同伴在旁边，我就不慌。
lines.en: With a companion nearby, I do not panic.

lines.zh: 太阳正好，我先吃一顿。
lines.en: The sun is just right, so I eat first.

lines.zh: 谁把我放在这的，我不记得了。
lines.en: I do not remember who put me here.

lines.zh: 新地方，新草，先尝一口。
lines.en: New place, new grass; I will taste it first.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛烧卷了，闻着像烤肉。
lines.en: My bristles curl in the heat and smell like roast meat.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，肚子先着地。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land on my belly.

lines.zh: 我在水里乱蹬，头一沉一浮。
lines.en: I kick wildly in the water, my head bobbing under and up.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响，站都站不稳。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing and my legs unsteady.

lines.zh: 背上一沉，多了根会疼的树枝。
lines.en: Something lands on my back: a branch that hurts.

lines.zh: 光一闪，我的腿就软了。
lines.en: A flash of light and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连草都啃不动。
lines.en: My belly is empty and I cannot even chew grass.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的毛全立起来了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every bristle on me stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我四蹄乱蹬也没用。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and my four hooves kick at nothing.
